source_requirements: The length of the random part of the result hyperlink shall be equal to or greater than 16 characters. This is to make it very very improbable that anybody can forge or guess a valid result link.
target_requirements: ['The length of the random part of the result hyperlink shall be equal to or greater than 16 characters.']

source_requirements: The result notification email shall contain a randomized result hyperlink to the results page.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall include a randomized result hyperlink to the results page into the result notification email.']

source_requirements: As soon as the results of a poll are published, the EVS shall send a notification email to all participants and organizers of the poll.
target_requirements: ['As soon as the results of a poll are published, the EVS shall send a notification email to all participants of the poll.', 'As soon as the results of a poll are published, the EVS shall send a notification email to all organizers of the poll.']

source_requirements: As soon as a poll is FINISHED and the number of submitted votes is at least 3, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to publish the results.
target_requirements: ['As soon as the poll is FINISHED and the number of submitted votes is at least 3, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to publish the results.']

source_requirements: As long as a poll is not FINISHED, the EVS shall ensure that nobody is able to view (intermediate) results.
target_requirements: ['As long as a poll is not FINISHED, the EVS shall ensure that nobody is able to view (intermediate) results.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that nobody is able to view results of polls with less than 3 submitted votes.
target_requirements: ['If the poll has less than 3 submitted votes, the EVS shall ensure that nobody is able to view the results.']

source_requirements: As soon as a poll is FINISHED and the number of submitted votes is at least 3, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to view the results of a poll.
target_requirements: ['As soon as a poll is FINISHED and the number of submitted votes is at least 3, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to view the results of a poll.']

source_requirements:
The system shall provide organizers to add different types of questions to a poll.
• SINGLE CHOICE with two or more items and one choice
• MULTIPLE CHOICE with two or more items
• YES/NO question with two items “yes” and “no” and one choice (indeed, this is a special case of SINGLE CHOICE questions)
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to add SINGLE CHOICE questions with two or more items and one choice to their polls.', 'The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to add MULTIPLE CHOICE questions with two or more items to their polls.', 'The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to add YES/NO questions with two items “yes” and “no” and one choice to their polls.']

source_requirements: The system should provide participants with the ability to abstain from voting for a complete poll (this is equivalent to abstention from all questions).
target_requirements: ['The system should provide participants with the ability to abstain from voting for a complete poll.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide participants with the ability to abstain from voting (Enthaltung oder ungültige Stimme) for each question of a poll.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide participants with the ability to abstain from voting for each question of a poll.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that subsequent participants using the same browser window can not restore the previous choices (e.g., by the „go back“ function or auto fill capabilities of browsers).
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall prevent that subsequent participants using the same browser window can restore the previous choices.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall discard all choices of a cancelled voting.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall discard all choices of cancelled votings.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide participants with the ability to cancel a voting, e.g., by closing the browser, or by clicking a cancel button. The token used in cancelled voting shall be re-useable later.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide participants with the ability to cancel a voting.', 'If the token is used in a cancelled voting, the EVS shall accept the token on later re-use.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that participants can not change their vote after submitting.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall prevent participants to change their vote after submitting.']

source_requirements: As soon as the vote was submitted, the EVS shall invalidate the token used for that vote, i.e., the token can’t be re-used.
target_requirements: ['As soon as the vote is submitted, the EVS shall invalidate the token used for that vote.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall present a button to submit a vote.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall present one button to submit votes.']

source_requirements: If a poll to clone has results, the EVS shall not clone the results.
target_requirements: ['If a poll to clone has results, the EVS shall clone the poll without results.']

source_requirements: As soon as the token was verified, the EVS shall display the questions and items.
target_requirements: ['As soon as the token is verified, the EVS shall display the questions and items.']

source_requirements: If a poll to clone has votes, the EVS shall not clone the votes.
target_requirements: ['If a poll to clone has votes, the EVS shall clone the poll without votes.']

source_requirements: If the voting page is accessed by the link in the notification email, the token input field should be pre-filled (see requirement PL04.2).
target_requirements: ['If the voting page is accessed by the link in the notification email, the EVS should pre-fill the token input field.']

source_requirements: The voting page shall present an input field for a participant’s token.
target_requirements: ['The voting page of the EVS shall provide participants with the ability to enter the token.']

source_requirements: The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to clone a poll (period, description, questions, participant list).
target_requirements: ['The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to clone their polls (period, description, questions, participant\nlist).']

source_requirements: As long as a poll is in state VOTING, the EVS shall provide a web page to submit a vote.
target_requirements: ['As long as the poll is in state VOTING, the EVS shall provide a web page to submit votes.']

source_requirements: If participation tracking is enabled for a poll, the EVS should provide organizers with the ability to activate automatic reminders to participants who didn’t vote.
target_requirements: ['If participation tracking is enabled for the poll, the EVS should provide organizers with the ability to activate automatic reminders to participants who didn’t vote.']

source_requirements: The system shall ensure that a token can not be associated with a vote.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall prevent tokens to be associated with votes.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to store participant lists for easy reuse in subsequent polls.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to store participant lists for easy reuse in subsequent polls.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall be designed in a way that the stored participant lists are private to each organizer.
target_requirements: ['The accessibility of stored participant lists in the EVS shall be private to each organizer.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall be designed in a way that all tokens are unique in the scope of the whole system.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall generate tokens that are unique in the scope of the whole system.']

source_requirements: The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to comfortably create participant lists, e.g., by pasting email addresses from other applications such as spread sheets or KLIPS.
target_requirements: ['The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to comfortably create participant lists.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure anonymity. At any point in time, it shall be impossible to identify which participant submitted which vote. This also shall to be guaranteed for polls with participation tracking.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall ensure anonymity with respect to impossibility at any point in time to identify which participant submitted which vote.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to track the participations for a poll.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to track the participations for polls.']

source_requirements: As soon as a poll is started, the EVS shall assign a random token to each participant of a poll.
target_requirements: ['As soon as a poll is started, the EVS shall assign a random token to each participant of a poll.']

source_requirements: The length of the tokens shall be equal to or greater than 16 characters. This is to make it very improbable that a valid token can be forged or guessed.
target_requirements: ['The length of the tokens in the EVS shall be equal to or greater than 16 characters.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall be designed in a way that a token that was previously issued can never be re-generated.
target_requirements: ['If a token that was previously issued, the EVS shall never re-generate that token.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to group arbitrary many questions into a poll.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to group arbitrary many questions into polls.']

source_requirements: Each stored participant list shall have a unique name (scope is per organizer).
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall store a name unique per organizer for each participant list.']

source_requirements: The notification email should contain a hyperlink that already contains a pre-filled token of the participant so that the participant can immediately begin to vote.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall include a hyperlink to the voting page that already contains a pre-filled token of the participant in the notification email on poll start.']

source_requirements: The notification email shall contain the poll title, description, voting period, the participant’s voting token, and a hyperlink to the voting page.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall include the poll title in the notification email on poll start.', 'The EVS shall include the poll description in the notification email on poll start.', "The EVS shall include the poll's voting period in the notification email on poll start.", 'The EVS shall include the participant’s voting token in the notification email on poll start.', 'The EVS shall include a hyperlink to the voting page in the notification email on poll start.']

source_requirements: The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to add participants from outside the university.
target_requirements: ['The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to add participants from outside the university.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that there are no duplicate entries in the participants of a poll.
target_requirements: ['The number of duplicate entries in the participant list of a poll in the EVS shall be 0.']

source_requirements: As long as a poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to add arbitrary many participants to a poll.
target_requirements: ['As long as the poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide owning organizers with the ability to add arbitrary many participants to the poll.']

source_requirements: Each participant shall be identified by a valid email address.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall identify each participant by a valid email address.']

source_requirements: As soon as a poll is started by an organizer, the EVS shall send a notification email to each participant. (The university’s mail server shall not be „mis-used“, it’s recommended to use the dummy/test SMTP server provided with the task)
target_requirements: ['As soon as a poll is started by an organizer, the EVS shall send a notification email to each participant.', 'As long as in test or demonstration phase, the EVS shall use a mail server different from the university mail server.', 'As long as in test or demonstration phase, the EVS should use the dummy/test SMTP server provided with the task.']

source_requirements: If LDAP is not used, the EVS shall provide administrators with the ability to manage organizer accounts (see OR01.2).
target_requirements: ['If LDAP is not used, the EVS shall provide administrators with the ability to manage organizer accounts.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that administrators can not access votes and results of polls that they don’t own.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall prevent administrators to access votes of polls that they do not own.', 'The EVS shall prevent administrators to access results of polls that they do not own.']

source_requirements: If the poll is not in state PREPARED, the EVS shall ensure that the participants of the poll can not be changed.
target_requirements: ['If the poll is not in state PREPARED, the EVS shall ensure that the participants of the poll can not be changed.']

source_requirements: If a poll to-delete is not in state PREPARED or FINISHED, the EVS shall send a notification email to all organizers and participants to inform about the removal.
target_requirements: ['If a poll to-delete is not in the state PREPARED or FINISHED, the EVS shall send a notification email to all organizers and participants to inform them about the removal.']

source_requirements: As soon as an organizer account is deleted, the EVS shall delete all polls that belong exclusively to that organizer (Polls with multiple organizers are not deleted.)
target_requirements: ['As soon as an organizer account is deleted, the EVS shall delete all polls that belong exclusively to that organizer.']

source_requirements: As soon as a poll has at least 3 participants and is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to start the poll.
target_requirements: ['As soon as a poll has at least 3 participants and is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to start the poll.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide administrators with the ability to delete any poll (including all votes and results).
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide administrators with the ability to delete any poll including all votes and results.']

source_requirements: If a poll to-delete is not in state PREPARED or FINISHED, the EVS shall send a notification email to all organizers and participants to inform them about the removal.
target_requirements: ['If a poll to-delete is not in the state PREPARED or FINISHED, the EVS shall send a notification email to all organizers and participants to inform them about the removal.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that an organizer can not remove herself from the organizer list.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to remove other organizers excluding themselves from the poll.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to delete a poll (including all votes and results).
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to delete a poll including all votes and results.']

source_requirements: As long as a poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to delete participants from the participants of a poll.
target_requirements: ['As long as a poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to delete participants from the participants of a poll.']

source_requirements: The number of questions of a poll shall be at least 1.
target_requirements: ['The number of questions of each poll in the EVS shall be at least 1.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to change the organizer list.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to change the organizer list.\xa0']

source_requirements: The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to add further organizers to a poll. The poll is then owned by each of the organizers
target_requirements: ['The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to add further owning organizers to a poll.']

source_requirements: Each poll shall be owned by at least one organizer (the creator is the initial owner).
target_requirements: ['The number of organizers of each poll in the EVS shall be at least one.\xa0', 'As soon as a poll is created, the EVS shall store the creator as the initial owner.\xa0']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that organizers only can work on polls that they own.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to work on polls that they own.']

source_requirements: The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to preview their polls in the participant view.
target_requirements: ['The EVS should provide organizers with the ability to preview their polls in the participant view\xa0']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to create arbitrary many polls.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to create arbitrary many polls.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall be able to identify university employees using the LDAP service provided by the GHRKO computing center.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall be able to identify university employees using the LDAP service provided by the GHRKO computing centre.\xa0']

source_requirements: As soon as the voting period starts, the EVS shall set the poll state to VOTING.
target_requirements: ['As soon as the voting period starts, the EVS shall set the poll state to VOTING.\xa0']

source_requirements: Each poll shall have a title. The title has to be unique (scope is system).
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall store a title unique within system scope for each poll.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide all university employees with the ability to act as organizers.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall provide all university employees with the ability to act as organizers.\xa0']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that organizers authenticate themselves with username and password.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall authenticate organizers with a username and password.\xa0']

source_requirements: The EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to extend (but not shorten) the voting period when a poll is in state STARTED or VOTING.
target_requirements: ['As long as a poll is in the state STARTED or VOTING, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to extend the voting period.\xa0']

source_requirements: As soon as the voting period ends or all participants have submitted their vote, the EVS shall set the poll state to FINISHED.
target_requirements: ['As soon as the voting period ends or all participants have submitted their vote, the EVS shall set the poll state to FINISHED.\xa0']

source_requirements: Each poll shall have a voting period (start and end date with time).
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall store a voting period (start and end date with time) for each poll.']

source_requirements: Each poll shall have a description.
target_requirements: ['The EVS shall store a description for each poll.']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that the participant list of a poll can only be changed in state PREPARED.
target_requirements: ['As long as the poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to change the participant list.', 'As long as the poll is not in state PREPARED, the EVS shall prevent changes of the participant list.']

source_requirements: As soon as an organizer starts a poll, the EVS shall set the poll state to STARTED.
target_requirements: ['As soon as an organizer starts a poll, the EVS shall set the poll state to STARTED.\xa0']

source_requirements: The EVS shall ensure that the description, initial voting period, questions, and participant list of a poll can only be changed in state PREPARED.
target_requirements: ['As long as the poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to change the description.', 'As long as the poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to change the initial voting period.', 'As long as the poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to change questions.\xa0', 'As long as the poll is in state PREPARED, the EVS shall provide organizers with the ability to change the participant list.\xa0', 'As long as the poll is not in state PREPARED, the EVS shall prevent changes of the description.', 'As long as the poll is not in state PREPARED, the EVS shall prevent changes of the initial voting period.', 'As long as the poll is not in state PREPARED, the EVS shall prevent changes of questions.\xa0', 'As long as the poll is not in state PREPARED, the EVS shall prevent changes of the participant list.\xa0']

source_requirements: The Electronic Voting System (EVS) shall provide organizers to conduct electronic polls.
target_requirements: ['The Electronic Voting System (EVS) shall provide organizers with the ability to conduct electronic polls.']
